name: Ripples in Miniature
description: A grand display tank modeled after those found within the Wingalet Fisharium. Boasting a spacious interior and exquisite aquascaping, it condenses a slice of the vast ocean world into a single, compact space.\nThrough some wondrous method, Tubby has produced a flawless replica of this fish tank within the Serenitea Pot. For the time being, however, the splendid scenery inside remains still and quiet, as if silently waiting for its very first finned visitors.
